summary: MTT-semantics for intersective vs subsective adjectives, transcribed from Chatzikyriakidis & Luo (2020) Appendix A7.3: intersective 'Irish' as a plain predicate with modified CNs as Sigma-types (Coq Records whose first projection is a coercion, giving Irishdelegate <= Delegate <= Human), subsective 'skillful' as a Pi-polymorphic predicate over the universe CN (Skillful : forall A:CN, A -> Prop). Three positive inferences proved by cbv+firstorder (some Irish delegate walks => some delegate walks; some man is Irish => some human is Irish; some skillful man is Irish => some man is Irish) and the signature subsective non-inference (some skillful surgeon => some skillful man) stated and aborted, exactly as in the source — the polymorphic typing makes Skillful Surgeon and Skillful Man distinct predicates. Depends on Coq_book_ontology.v (CN := Set, CNs as Parameters, subtyping via Axiom-declared coercion functions, quantifiers some/all/no as definitions), which mirrors the book's Appendix A7.1.

sources.citation: Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories. ISTE/Wiley. Ch. 6 (Reasoning and Verifying NL Semantics in Coq), sec. 3.3, and Appendix A7.3 (pp. 194-195) — the file is a near-verbatim transcription of A7.3.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2013). Adjectives in a Modern Type-Theoretical Setting. LACL 2013 — the underlying analysis of subsective adjectives as polymorphic predicates.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2014). Natural Language Inference in Coq. J. Logic, Language and Information 23(4) — the Irish-delegate Sigma-type inference (their (25)-(27)).

evidence: The file is a line-for-line transcription of Appendix A7.3 (pp. 194-195) of the 2020 book up to the spelling skilful -> Skillful, verified against the PDF text (including the book's own 'Abort all' ending for skill2).
All three positive inferences the appendix claims (delegate1, delegate2, skill1) end in Qed via cbv+firstorder, the book's own proof scripts.
The blocked inference skill2 is stated and aborted exactly as the source presents it, exhibiting the intended failure of Skillful Surgeon -> Skillful Man under polymorphic typing.

The loaded Coq_book_ontology.v reproduces the book's Appendix A7.1 layer (CN := Set, Parameters for CNs, Axiom-declared coercions, quantifier definitions); grep counts: 4 theorem declarations, 0 Admitted, 3 signature Parameters in this file.
omissions: Covers only Appendix A7.3; the book's neighboring adjective material (privative 'fake' A7.4, multidimensional A7.5, gradable A7.6) lives in sibling ttr_mtt files, not here.
The non-derivability of skill2 is only evidenced by an aborted attempt (the source's own evidence); no countermodel or independence argument is given.

determination_rationale: The source's own Coq appendix is reproduced exactly and all its claimed inferences behave as stated (three Qed, one blocked). But the theory is stated in UTT with a genuine universe CN and native coercive subtyping, and its Coq rendering — the book's own — needs two documented substrate substitutions: CN := Set (the book's fn. 12: 'we use Set to define CN, although CN should have been a separate universe' — a class (ii) type-universe collapse) and subtyping as Axiom-declared coercion functions with no propagation through Sigma (the book: 'a limitation of the system in Coq'), so Sigma(A,P) <= Sigma(B,P) inferences are out of reach (class iv). These do not change the fragment's predictions, so slight modification rather than as-is; nothing required re-founding.

artifact_classes.description: CN := Set collapses the intended universe of common nouns into Coq's Set (the source's own documented workaround, book fn. 12); polymorphic Skillful quantifies over this stand-in universe

no native coercive subtyping: coercions axiomatized as function constants (Axiom dh: Delegate->Human etc. in the loaded ontology) and no subtyping propagation through Sigma constructors, which the book flags as a Coq limitation

notes: Record produced by the batch audit sweep of 2026-09-05; the file predates the atlas zero-axiom discipline (3 signature Parameters here plus the loaded ontology's function-typed coercion Axioms — none propositional, per rubric sec. 3a).
